parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular in shape, forming one of the front panels of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a movable cover to access the storage space inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the cabinet frame.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A lower cabinet door made of MDF, part of the front enclosure of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lower storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed on hinges.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: An upper cabinet door made of MDF, forming part of the upper front section.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the upper storage area.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: Another upper cabinet door made of MDF, paired with the adjacent door for symmetrical access.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the upper right storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open on hinges attached to the frame.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, forming the outer shell and support structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and supports the doors and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part of the cabinet.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal shelf made of particle board, fitted inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet interior into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of particle board, forming part of the internal structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items within the cabinet.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: An upper shelf made of particle board, dividing the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports lighter items stored in the upper compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during normal operation.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A top shelf made of particle board, forming the uppermost internal division.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space near the top of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place during use.
